claim_summary: Exact full-distribution swap factorization for four equal-size rooted binary subtrees grouped alike versus crosswise; third-moment gap is a negative square. The published sixteen-leaf first two-moment collision threshold is prior work.
integrity: Complete algebraic generating-polynomial factorization and independent finite checks for the explicit sixteen-leaf example; best-of-knowledge originality is limited to the full-distribution identity, not the earlier rarefaction threshold.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge rooted full-binary shapes, equal-size swapped subtrees, uniform independent leaf extinction; strict third-moment separation when incoming-edge means differ. The first-collision threshold and uniqueness at sixteen leaves were previously published in the fixed-size rarefaction model and are not new.
title: Exact full-distribution swap identity for future rooted phylogenetic diversity
